definitions.explanation: Digital currency that uses cryptography for security and operates on decentralized networks, typically blockchain technology. Not issued by a central bank or government.

examples.japanese: {仮想通貨|かそうつうか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{支払|しはら}う→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧。
{仮想通貨|かそうつうか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{急落|きゅうらく}→急落：09399_kyuuraku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{仮想通貨|かそうつうか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取引所|とりひきじょ}→取引所：17223_torihikijo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{口座|こうざ}→口座：05419_kouza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開設|かいせつ}→開設：14595_kaisetsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To open an account at a cryptocurrency exchange.

examples.japanese: {仮想通貨|かそうつうか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: Profits from cryptocurrency are subject to taxes.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY: ⟦{仮想|かそう}→仮想：17756_kasou⟧ (virtual) + ⟦{通貨|つうか}→通貨：03508_tsuuka⟧ (currency). The term emphasizes that this currency exists only digitally, not as physical coins or bills.

TERMINOLOGY NOTE: Japan officially uses ⟦{暗号資産|あんごうしさん}→暗号資産：16614_angoushisan⟧ (cryptographic assets) in legal and regulatory contexts since 2019, but {仮想通貨|かそうつうか} remains the common everyday term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仮想通貨|かそうつうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to purchase cryptocurrency)
- {仮想通貨|かそうつうか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{投資|とうし}→投資：04711_toushi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to invest in cryptocurrency)
- {仮想通貨|かそうつうか}⟦{取引所|とりひきじょ}→取引所：17223_torihikijo⟧ (cryptocurrency exchange)
